en: Changed worktree isolation: an isolated worktree session or agent is now refused `git bisect run`, `git maintenance register|start` and `scalar`'s set-up commands, and is told what still works
zh: 变更 worktree 隔离：隔离的 worktree session 或 agent 现在会被拒绝执行 `git bisect run`、`git maintenance register|start` 以及 `scalar` 的初始化命令，并会被告知哪些操作仍可用
